task.instruction: Research the new features of the iOS 17 on Apple support and check its compatibility with the iPhone 12.

final_answer:
**iPhone 12 compatibility:** Yes. Apple's "iPhone models compatible with iOS 17" page lists iPhone 12, iPhone 12 mini, iPhone 12 Pro and iPhone 12 Pro Max as supported. The full list runs from iPhone XR, XS and XS Max up to the iPhone 15 series, plus iPhone SE (2nd and 3rd generation). To update, go to Settings > General > Software Update.

**New features in iOS 17** (from Apple's "About iOS 17 Updates" page):
- **Phone, Messages and FaceTime:** Contact Posters and Live Voicemail. Messages gets Live Stickers, Check In, audio message transcription, better search and swipe-to-reply. FaceTime gets video and audio messages and Reactions.
- **StandBy:** a full-screen display for when iPhone is on its side and charging. It has clocks, photos and widgets, plus a red Night Mode.
- **Interactive widgets:** you can take actions directly from the widget. iPhone widgets can also appear on a Mac desktop.
- **AirDrop:** NameDrop shares contact details when two iPhones are held close together. You can also start AirDrop or SharePlay this way.
- **Keyboard:** more accurate autocorrect, plus inline predictive text and better sentence corrections.
- **Safari and passwords:** Profiles, locked Private Browsing, link tracking protection, and shared passwords and passkeys.
- **Other updates:** Offline Maps, Music crossfade, AirPlay suggestions, saying "Siri" without "Hey", and an expanded Visual Look Up.
- **Health:** State of Mind logging and Screen Distance.
- **Accessibility:** Assistive Access, Live Speech, Personal Voice and Point and Speak.
- **Later updates:** the Journal app (17.2), Stolen Device Protection (17.3), and Apple Podcasts transcripts and new emoji (17.4).

**Features that apply to iPhone 12:** Apple marks the improved autocorrect, enhanced sentence corrections and inline predictive text as "iPhone 12 and later". So iPhone 12 gets those. Some other features need newer models, such as the iPhone 14 satellite features and the iPhone 15 Pro Action button options. Features also vary by region.

judge.rationale: The compatibility page explicitly lists iPhone 12 models, and the agent accessed Apple Support’s “About iOS 17 Updates” page before summarizing iOS 17 features.
